defs: spoke in a short, angry voice
said something in an angry way
answered with a cross voice
exs: "Leave me alone!" my brother snapped at me.
The tired teacher snapped when the class was too loud.
Dad snapped, "Stop running in the house!"

defs: in a way that looks like you did nothing wrong
as if you know nothing about it
in a sweet way, with no bad plan
exs: The boy smiled innocently when Mom asked about the cookies.
She looked innocently at the teacher and said, "Who, me?"
My dog sat innocently next to the broken cup.

defs: seems to be true
looks like it is so
seems when you look at it
exs: It appears that it will rain, so take your umbrella.
It appears that my cat is asleep on the sofa.
The test appears easy, but it is hard.

defs: a place that is dirty or not neat
a lot of things all over the floor
things that are not put away
exs: Please clean up the mess in your room.
The kids made a big mess with paint.
My puppy left a mess on the floor.

defs: a cold yellow drink made from lemons
a sweet sour drink that you drink on hot days
a drink made with lemon, water, and sugar
exs: On a hot day, I like cold lemonade.
Mom made a big jug of lemonade for the party.
We sold lemonade at our little stand.

defs: not smart; silly
not clever at all
showing a lack of good thinking
exs: That was a dumb mistake, but I fixed it.
He felt dumb when he forgot his own name.
It is not nice to call a friend dumb.

defs: the things that a person does
what you do, not what you say
ways that people act
exs: Your kind actions make everyone in class happy.
Good actions are better than nice words.
The teacher said our actions at school are important.

defs: say that you are not happy about something
tell people that something is bad
say what you do not like
exs: Do not complain about the food, just eat it.
Some people complain when the bus is late.
My sister likes to complain about her homework.

defs: take something to a person's home
bring things to people
carry mail or papers to a house
exs: The postman will deliver the letter this morning.
I get up early to deliver milk to our neighbors.
The pizza man came to deliver our dinner.

defs: spoke in a low voice that is hard to hear
said something quietly and not clearly
talked softly to himself
exs: "I do not know," the shy boy mumbled.
She mumbled her answer, so nobody could hear.
Grandpa mumbled something while he read the news.

defs: in a clean and tidy way
with everything in the right place
in a careful way, not messy
exs: She put her books neatly on the shelf.
Please write your name neatly on the paper.
The clothes were folded neatly in the drawer.

defs: able to wait without getting angry
calm when things take a long time
not in a hurry or upset
exs: Please be patient, the bus will come soon.
A good teacher is kind and patient.
I tried to be patient while my dog learned to sit.

defs: show that something is true
give a way to show you are right
make people see it is true
exs: I can prove that I did my homework.
He ran fast to prove he was the best.
Can you prove that the cat took the fish?

defs: not able to understand something
confused and not sure what is going on
wondering why something happened
exs: I felt puzzled when my bag was not on my desk.
The puzzled boy looked at the hard math question.
She looked puzzled when the lights went out.

defs: the way you go from one place to another
the road you take to get somewhere
the places you visit on your way
exs: My bus route goes past the school.
The mail carrier follows the same route every day.
We took a different route to the park.

defs: thin round pieces of stretchy material
small stretchy circles used to hold things together
stretchy loops that tie papers or hair
exs: I put two rubber bands around the pencils.
Rubber bands can hold my homework papers together.
The girl used rubber bands to tie up her hair.

defs: go away so you cannot see it
suddenly disappear
be here, then not be here
exs: Watch the magician make the coin vanish.
My cookies seem to vanish when I leave the room.
The rabbit can vanish into the tall grass.

defs: tell everyone something in a loud voice
say important news to many people
tell people what will happen
exs: The teacher will announce the winner of the game.
Please announce that lunch is ready.
Dad will announce our trip at dinner.

defs: take care of children while their parents are away
look after a small child for money
stay with kids when parents go out
exs: I baby-sit my little cousin on Saturday nights.
My big sister will baby-sit for our neighbor.
Can you baby-sit the twins while we go shopping?

defs: a small bowl of water for birds in a garden
a place where birds drink and play in water
a shallow dish of water outside
exs: A small bird sat on the birdbath and drank water.
We put water in the birdbath every morning.
The birdbath in the garden is full of birds.

defs: in a glad way
with a smile and good feelings
in a way that shows joy
exs: The kids played happily in the park.
She happily opened the box from Grandma.
My dog wagged his tail happily.

defs: stopped for a short time
stopped talking or moving for a moment
waited a little before going on
exs: He paused at the door to look for his key.
The girl paused to think about the question.
The singer paused, then began the next song.

defs: act as if something is real when it is not
make believe
play a game of acting
exs: Let's pretend we are lions in the zoo.
The little girl likes to pretend she is a doctor.
I pretend this box is my spaceship.

defs: give some of what you have to others
let other people have a part
use something together with someone
exs: Please share your cake with your friends.
I will share my crayons with my sister.
Good friends share their snacks at lunch.

defs: make something very wet
put something in water for a long time
wet all the way through
exs: Please do not soak my new shoes in the water.
Mom will soak the dirty dishes in the sink.
The big wave can soak us at the beach.
